text: Program Description Biomedical engineering is a discipline that solves related problems in medicine, safeguards human health, and serves for the prevention, diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation of diseases. It is a highly integrated interdisciplinary subject, which is its biggest characteristic. Biomedical engineering its theories and methods of the integrated engineering, biology and medicine, on all levels to study the change of state of human body system, and using the engineering technology to control this kind of change of biomedical engineering professional training with life science, electronic technology, computer technology and information science on the basis of theoretical knowledge and the combination of medicine and engineering scientific research ability, can in the field of biomedical engineering, medical instruments and other electronic technology, computer technology and information industry departments engaged in research, development, teaching and management of senior engineering and technical personnel. Future Career Student employment mainly go to research institutions, the hospital image, equipment, clinical engineering, information center and other related departments, medical apparatus and instruments related enterprises, institutions, government management departments, etc. Duration 3 years
